question: Title: Rangers vs. White Sox — Who wins? (Aug 24)

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Texas Rangers": Wins if the Texas Rangers have a higher final score than the Chicago White Sox in their MLB game played on August 24, 2026.
- "Chicago White Sox": Wins if the Chicago White Sox have a higher final score than the Texas Rangers in their MLB game played on August 24, 2026.

Clarifications:
- If the game is suspended and completed on a later date, the official final score at completion is used. If the game is postponed and not played on August 24, 2026, the market is void.
